info.title: Linked-device pairing identity contract
info.description: Pairer-supplied pairing identity on the ceremony POST. client_label and platform are pairer-supplied, non-attestation, and non-authorization: they do not grant device-door access. A certificate is authorized only by a unique fingerprint in link/authorized_clients.json. Direct and relay carriers are equivalent for these fields. Validation runs for every nonce role, including peer, before nonce consumption.

post.description: Complete a one-shot pairing ceremony. Identity fields live in the flattened additional_fields of PairRequest (client_label, platform). Direct and relay admissions apply the same field rules.

400.description: Pairing request invalid, including invalid pairing identity fields

client_label.description: Pairer-supplied label. Valid on the wire iff the UTF-8 byte length is 1-253 (no charset restriction). Empty, wrong JSON type, or more than 253 UTF-8 bytes is refused before nonce consume. JSON Schema minLength counts characters; the byte bound is x-max-utf8-bytes.

platform.description: Closed pairer-supplied platform vocabulary. Empty string, wrong JSON type, or any other value is refused before nonce consume. There is no present-empty read-back state.

x-pairing-identity.validation: before nonce consume, every role including peer
x-pairing-identity.combined: either field malformed => Unavailable, no companion fallback
